lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 7 visible vertical columns of circular high-luminance pixel clusters, each containing 3 to 5 nodes. Spatial distribution is roughly equidistant across the mid-flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance bands intersect with horizontal spot alignments to create a rectilinear grid between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin coordinates.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as three horizontal linear vectors with sharp vertical luminance gradients (bright upper, dark lower). The medial carina is most distinct, extending from the fifth gill slit towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 high-luminance blobs are visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated in the anterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A transition from discrete macro-spots on the flank to a significantly denser, smaller-diameter point-cloud distribution of pixel maxima on the rostrum and head area.
